text: The capital of France is Paris. It sits on the banks of the Seine river in the north of the country.
The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair.
The Seine is a major river of northern France. It flows through Paris before reaching the English Channel.
Python is a high-level programming language. It is widely used for data science, scripting, and web development.
NumPy is a Python library for numerical computing. It provides fast multi-dimensional array operations.
Bananas are an elongated edible fruit. They are rich in potassium and grow in tropical climates.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy. Plants use chlorophyll to absorb sunlight and release oxygen.
The mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell. They produce ATP, the energy currency that drives cellular metabolism.
